channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 18
item.description:
63 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Temporarily disabled tool cupboard occlusion checks, preventing hidden tool cupboards from granting base authorization until auth networking is moved out of the tool cupboard.
  • Loadout system now saves and restores item positions when creating or deploying loadouts, preserving player inventory layout.
  • Shearing improvements: wild sheep can be sheared but will flee when approached, shearing tools now use generic harvesting properties, and sheep corpses retain shaved state and correct pose, preventing floating or unshaved corpses.
  • Added new bull and cow trophy models to the large hunting trophy prefab, expanding the trophy collection.
  • Crab swarms now move together with individual random speeds based on size, improving their behavior during raids.
  • Localization updates are now applied, fixing missing or incorrect text in the UI.

Base & Authorization

  • Temporarily disabled tool cupboard occlusion checks, preventing hidden tool cupboards from granting base authorization until auth networking is moved out of the tool cupboard.

Inventory & Loadouts

  • Loadout system now saves and restores item positions when creating or deploying loadouts, preserving player inventory layout.

Livestock & Resources

  • Shearing improvements: wild sheep can be sheared but will flee when approached, shearing tools now use generic harvesting properties, and sheep corpses retain shaved state and correct pose, preventing floating or unshaved corpses.
  • Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources, and pregnancies are blocked when condition falls below 60%, reducing unintended resource generation.

Hunting & Trophies

  • Added new bull and cow trophy models to the large hunting trophy prefab, expanding the trophy collection.

New Threats & Gameplay Systems

  • Introduced crab swarms as a new hostile NPC group.
  • Added dedicated subsystems for compass, detonator, and master key, removing their old holdtype controllers.

Stability & Bug Fixes

  • Fixed NaN water height issue that could cause terrain or player positioning glitches.
  • Resolved error when selecting a player in the Animator window, preventing in‑game crashes.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Crab swarms now move together with individual random speeds based on size, improving their behavior during raids.
  • Boat vendor dialogue on floating cities now correctly indicates the direction to find your purchased boat.

Localization

  • Localization updates are now applied, fixing missing or incorrect text in the UI.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 17
item.description:
110 development commits

Combat & Targeting

  • Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, fixing a limitation where they only reacted to client projectiles.
  • Distance2D calculations now correctly use true 2‑D distance, fixing range‑related bugs.
  • Low‑health heartbeat sound now ramps up with intensity and fades after 3 seconds of health loss, making danger more noticeable.

Crafting & Food Buffs

  • Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant extra duration, higher yield, healing, max HP and other buffs.
  • Brioche Bread recipe adds a 25 % boost to bread stats and requires eggs and cream.
  • Key recipe costs reduced (stone and cloth) and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.

World & Environment

  • Water‑level generation no longer produces NaN values, eliminating water‑height glitches.
  • Triangle foundations no longer incorrectly connect buildings that only touch at a corner.

Vehicles & Controls

  • Seat‑swap action added across all vehicle controls and a consistent car reload button binding introduced.
  • Stirring a biofuel generator mounts the player at their position; releasing E stops mounting, and a ‘no electricity’ status appears if the generator lacks power.

Livestock & AI

  • Livestock spread out when feeding to avoid crowding the trough, and sheep corpse colliders now behave correctly.
  • Navmesh generation issues fixed, preventing meshes on fences and improving NPC pathing.

Achievements

  • New achievements added for mailing a note to another player, buying from the travelling vendor, and triggering a satellite crash event.

Multiplayer & Matchmaking

  • Quick join menu now reliably shows server entries without disappearing.
  • Quick join menu now displays entries (previously empty).

Building & Creative

  • Painting UI now includes a colour wheel for neon signs, larger size option (up to 25mm), and optional brush outline toggle for better visibility.

Combat & Animations

  • Sheep charge attack animation fixed, ensuring proper attack behavior.

Vehicle Controls

  • Toggle duck feature works correctly on non-modular car vehicles.

UI Stability

  • Flexbox UI layout error resolved, preventing out-of-range crashes in UI panels.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 16
item.description:
90 development commits

Livestock & Animals

  • Fixed gender assignment when purchasing animals.
  • Sheep now drop wool when sheared; introduced a wool item that stacks to 100 and can be sold to the stables vendor via the auction system, with tiered rewards based on total wool (up to 1000) and a three‑strike rejection limit that locks the vendor for 15 minutes.
  • Implemented an animal‑trading auction: players receive three item bundles per sale, can reject bundles a limited number of times before the vendor becomes unavailable; vendor UI now only shows animals following the speaking player, annoyance is tied to the animal, and auction results wait for dialogue to finish.
  • AI improvements for livestock and critters: cows avoid clipping and can eat from blocked troughs, bear flee logic corrected, critters startle and flee when players approach (no longer startle each other), sight ranges reduced, and legacy animal states simplified.

Powerlevel Loot Tweaks

  • Adjusted loot tables for the Trainyard, Water Treatment, and Sewer power‑level rooms.

Combat & Explosives

  • Improved C4 client prediction, fixed rotation blending over its full range, and refined hide/show event handling for more reliable C4 behavior.

World Events & Monuments

  • Added a new oil‑rig switch event to the monument system and introduced extra air‑drop and satellite selection events.

Structures & Crafting

  • Overhauled sandbag stacking and upgrades: only the default sandbag is craftable, upgrade cooldowns fixed, health retention during upgrades configurable, placement checks tightened to prevent clipping, and upgrade visuals improved.

Economy & Trading

  • Expanded the sell table with several guns for testing purposes.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed country selection UI bugs: automatic rows now match country rows and auto‑detect works reliably, preventing mismatched selections.
  • Remote players now rotate fully instead of snapping to the shortest turn, improving combat visual consistency.
  • Server can now toggle god mode via ServerSetGod, fixing tutorial god‑mode disabling and allowing server‑side control.
  • Added extra placement checks for sandbag and barricade stacking, preventing invalid builds and ensuring proper placement.
  • Upgrade placement now hides the existing mesh and shows only the placement guide, reducing visual clutter during building upgrades.
  • Introduces a revamped country selection interface with continent grouping and tab‑based navigation.
  • Livestock now more reliably avoid water, reducing accidental drowning and improving herd movement.
  • Animals gain water‑avoidance preferences in roaming and fleeing behaviors, making them less likely to enter water hazards.
